title: Dentsply Sirona’s Primescan 2 Cart Wins 2026 Red Dot Award
html:
Key features include intuitive usability, highlighted by an integrated display that enhances patient understanding of scan results and supports informed treatment decisions.

Dentsply Sirona announced that Primescan 2 Cart has been honored with the 2026 Red Dot Award: Product Design, one of the world’s most respected design competitions. The award recognizes the company’s commitment to developing innovative technologies that combine outstanding functionality, intuitive usability, and exceptional design.

Primescan 2 Cart supports efficient workflows and greater flexibility for dental practices. Its compact footprint, ergonomic design, and mobility allow clinicians to seamlessly integrate digital scanning into everyday practice while enhancing patient communication.

Designed with both clinicians and patients in mind, Primescan 2 Cart features optimized dimensions to improve access during scanning procedures, a streamlined surface that supports efficient disinfection, and an integrated display that enhances patient understanding and engagement.

“At Dentsply Sirona, we are committed to creating solutions that make digital dentistry more efficient, intuitive, and accessible,” said Johannes Krug, vice president of Connected Technology Solutions at Dentsply Sirona. “This Red Dot Award reflects our dedication to combining technology with thoughtful design to help dental professionals deliver exceptional patient care.”

About Red Dot

The Red Dot Design Award is one of the world’s leading design competitions, recognizing excellence in Product Design, Brands & Communication Design, and Design Concept. Judged by independent international experts, the award celebrates innovative solutions that combine outstanding design, functionality, and business value.

About Dentsply Sirona

Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest diversified manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with more than a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world-class brands.

Dentsply Sirona’s innovative products provide high-quality, effective, and connected solutions to advance patient care and deliver better and safer dental care. Dentsply Sirona is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. The company’s shares are listed in the United States on Nasdaq under the symbol XRAY.

Visit www.dentsplysirona.com for more information about Dentsply Sirona and its products.
